metadata.suite_name: SmartHire Knowledge Graph Pipeline SHAP Validation

baseline_provenance.provenance: Observed empirical pass rates over authentic Kaggle resume cohort

methodological_declarations.algebraic_additivity_vs_faithfulness: Algebraic additivity (sum(phi_i) == Score - E[Score]) is an exact mathematical property of the closed-form Shapley game over linearly separable requirements, not an empirical proof of explanation faithfulness. Faithfulness is independently validated via AOPC feature-perturbation decay.
methodological_declarations.predictive_validity_limitation: Predictive validity against real-world human job performance is uncompleted because open-source resume corpora lack human post-hire ratings or validated competence ground truth.
methodological_declarations.llm_explainability_boundary: SHAP attributions explain the deterministic candidate-matching score (Graph_ATS). Unstructured text generated by multi-agent LLM prompts is probabilistic and is not explained by SHAP.

perturbation_faithfulness.scientific_interpretation: Comprehensiveness decay significantly exceeds sufficiency decay (mean ratio > 1.0). Removing top-SHAP features reduces the candidate match score, while removing null-player non-technical tokens preserves the score, confirming attribution faithfulness.
